results.case: N1 recovery: back/forward offers draft; restore yields exact description, zero writes
N2 recovery: shell leave/return -> cancel discard keeps offer; confirm removes cache only
N3 recovery: real reload dismiss retains; accepted reload offers, restore exact
N4 save: CAS current, source+Builder once, exact cache removed, saved state
N5 deferred write + newer edit: stale ack keeps newer draft/dirty; retry uses latest CAS
N6 owner isolation: B sees no A offer; A returns -> offer
N7 changed backend: warn+confirm; forbidden fields dropped; save CAS new version
N8 storage failure: warning shown, edits retained, no false backup, save works
N9 mid-offer write: stale discard retains new rev; storage-fail reread preserves offer
N10 pending blocks handlers; restore+undo+redo syncs cache, CAS latest
